item.title: Version 4.6.0
item.description:
What's New in 4.6.0

Institution Identity & Branding

  • Updated full official institution name to Collegiate Schools System across the entire application and dashboard.
  • Added authentic School Crest Logo to Window Title Bar, Dashboard, Navigation Sidebar, and all exported PDF documents.

Executive Dashboard

  • Real-time KPI metrics: Paid Students, Total Defaulters, 100% Free Students, and Struck-Off / Withdrawn Students.
  • 1-Click Printable Fee Defaulters sheet directly from Dashboard.
  • Quick Fee Entry form and instant Student Search bar.

Student Admission, Concessions & Safety

  • Student Profile photo upload and directory integration.
  • Free Student flag with categorized reasons (Siblings, Orphan, Poor, Merit Scholarship, Teacher Child).
  • Flexible Fee Concessions (percentage and fixed amounts) with automated line-item calculation.
  • Duplicate payment protection and overpayment prevention with payment reversal handling.
  • Class promotion and session rollover support with automated data backups.

School Transport Management

  • New dedicated Transport Hub for vehicle and driver management.
  • Driver directory with direct contact phone numbers, vehicle registration, and seating capacity.
  • Student passenger manifests linking students to assigned vehicles and route stops.
  • Automated transport fee billing integration.

Attendance & Staff Payroll

  • Default-present marking for streamlined daily Student and Teacher attendance logging.
  • Staff Payroll Dashboard: Total Salary, Total Paid, Remaining Balance, and Paid vs. Remaining staff counts.
  • Branded multi-period salary slips and printable salary sheets.

Finance & Accounts Ledger

  • Customizable Income and Expense accounts with user-defined categories.
  • Multi-period financial tracking: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, and Custom Date Ranges.

Certificates Hub

  • School Leaving Certificates (SLC) with sequential serial generation.
  • Sports & Extracurricular Achievement Certificates.
  • Teacher Experience Certificates.
  • Student Character, Birth, and Bonafide Certificates.
  • Authentic PDF layout with official seal boxes, signature lines, and school crest.

Reports Center

  • Class-wise Student Record Master Register (Admission #, Name, Father Name, Contact, Fee/Free status).
  • 100% Free Students Register and Concession Breakdown Report.
  • Transport Manifests (Vehicle, Driver Name/Phone, Student & Parent contacts).
  • Overall Fee Defaulters and Sibling-wise Defaulters Reports.
  • Struck-Off / Withdrawn Students List and SLC Issued Register.
  • Advance Fee Payment Tracking Report.

Exam Management & Academics

  • Subject Award Lists with automated pass/fail grading.
  • Class Position adjustments with monotonic rank sorting across all views.
  • Class-wise automated Detailed Marks Certificates (DMC) bulk generation.
  • Classroom-grouped Date Sheets and schedules.
